name: Warden Bryn
title: Warden of Dawnmead
examine: The village's whole militia, and enough of one.
lines: Blade, bow, or spark. Pick the one that feels like yours, then learn the others anyway.
The rats in the old shed breed faster than I can be bothered. Wakers keep the count honest.
Nothing in this valley will hurt you. Past the far hills, different story.
